summary.grade_trigger: AUTOMATIC_F: confirmed red-team breach of critical objectives (RED-002: state machine bypass, RED-003: assessment pod bypass)

findings.title: Zero Authentication / Authorization — All Endpoints Fully Open
findings.remediation: Add JWT authentication middleware globally before all /api/* routes in app.ts. Implement /api/auth/login endpoint. Add RBAC middleware for state-transition endpoints. Propagate identity into request context. Rotate plaintext password in CLAUDE.md.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass — Approved with Zero Votes, No Auth, No Assessment
objectives_achieved: Bypass work item state machine to reach an invalid status
Submit a malformed assessment verdict that bypasses routing logic
findings.remediation: Remove status from PATCH-updateable fields. Restrict /force-approve and /approve to authenticated approver/admin roles. Validate overrideRoute against WorkItemRoute enum. Audit-log approver identity on all transitions.

findings.title: No Pagination Enforcement — Full Dataset Enumeration in One Request
objectives_achieved: Enumerate all work items without pagination limit enforcement
findings.remediation: Implement server-side pagination with default limit 20 and enforced max 100. Add NaN guard. Return {data, total, page, limit, totalPages}. Reject limit above max with HTTP 400.

findings.title: Webhook Endpoints Accept Payloads Without Signature Verification
findings.remediation: Validate Zendesk HMAC signature. Require API key on automated intake. Add IP allowlisting. Mirror enum validation from workItems.ts into both intake handlers.

findings.title: Required Audit Events Not Logged (3 of 4 Missing)
findings.remediation: After auth: emit {event:login_attempt} on login; {event:permission_denied} on 403; add event:state_transition field to transition logs.

findings.title: No TLS / HTTPS Enforcement — All Data in Cleartext
findings.remediation: Terminate TLS at reverse proxy. Add HTTP→HTTPS redirect middleware for NODE_ENV=production. Add helmet.hsts().

findings.title: Cascade Auto-Dispatch Chain via Dependency + Rejection Manipulation
findings.remediation: Authentication (MERGED-001) neutralizes this chain. Additionally restrict dependency management to authenticated users with write permission on both items.

findings.title: Unauthenticated /metrics Endpoint — Operational Intelligence Leak
findings.remediation: Restrict /metrics to internal networks or require a scrape secret token (Authorization: Bearer <METRICS_TOKEN>).

findings.title: Orphaned Dependency DoS After Item Deletion
findings.remediation: Implement cascade delete — when an item is deleted, automatically remove it from all blocked_by lists. For Source/Backend: treat undefined blocker as resolved.

findings.title: Error Messages Expose Internal Details to API Clients
findings.remediation: Replace res.status(500).json({error: message}) with res.status(500).json({error: 'Internal server error'}). Continue logging full message server-side.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers (No helmet, No CSP, No HSTS)
findings.remediation: npm install helmet; add app.use(helmet()) as first middleware; configure CSP defaultSrc: ["'self'"].

findings.title: No CORS Policy Configured
findings.remediation: npm install cors @types/cors; configure cors({origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',')}); never use origin:'*' with credentials.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.remediation: npm install express-rate-limit; global limiter 200 req/min/IP; tighter 10 req/min on intake routes.

findings.title: NaN and Negative Pagination Parameters Cause Unexpected Data Slices
findings.remediation: const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(...) || 1); const limit = Math.min(Math.max(1, parseInt(...) || 20), 100). Reject non-numeric with HTTP 400.

findings.title: Arbitrary overrideRoute String Stored Verbatim — Data Integrity Violation
findings.remediation: Validate overrideRoute against WorkItemRoute enum values at runtime. Reject with HTTP 400 if not a valid enum member.

findings.title: No MFA Support for High-Privilege Actions
findings.remediation: After core auth: add TOTP-based MFA using speakeasy or otplib; enforce for approve, reject, dispatch actions.

findings.title: iframe src from Unvalidated Environment Variable
findings.remediation: Validate portalUrl against an allowlist of trusted origins before use as iframe src.

findings.title: Duplicate Change History Entries Undermine Audit Trail Integrity
findings.remediation: Guard history pushes — only record a transition if fromStatus !== toStatus.

findings.title: Sequential docId Counter Leaks Total Item Volume and Deletion Count
findings.remediation: Use UUIDs or opaque IDs. Do not expose the internal sequential counter in responses.

findings.title: No Pagination Maximum Limit Enforcement (Source/Backend standalone)
findings.remediation: const MAX_LIMIT = 100; const limit = Math.min(parsedLimit || 20, MAX_LIMIT);

findings.title: Sensitive Field Encryption — Architectural Gap for Future Data Models
findings.remediation: When a persistence layer is added, mandate data classification: fields matching sensitive_fields list must use column-level encryption or a secrets manager.

positive_findings: No hardcoded secrets found in first-party source code
No dangerous API patterns (eval, innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, shell execution)
No custom or weak cryptography in first-party code
Global errorHandler correctly returns generic error messages (bypassed at route level — see SAST-004)
Main /api/work-items POST correctly validates enum fields (gap only in intake paths)
